patches.decision_note: The missing bullet, theme colors, and caption formatting are atomic observations already owned by narrower style Requirements; retaining an umbrella coverage failure duplicates those observations.
The client asks for the field problem to be fixed but does not resolve which editable-field mechanism should replace the disputed legacy controls.
The inability to use Enter in a specific interactive text area concerns multiline-field admission and is already represented under REQ_MULTILINE_FIELD_ENTRY.
The partial Enter failure belongs to the narrower multiline-field Requirement; the separate spacing clause is represented by the content-spacing lifecycle.
The Enter claim targets multiline field operation, while the margin and spacing clauses target layout spacing; it does not independently claim corrected paragraph-break semantics.
The headline field's inability to accept Enter is a post-claim failure of multiline field entry, not evidence about paragraph spacing after a hard return.
Fixed margins preventing icon clipping and internal right/top/bottom spacing have separate acceptance criteria and separate failure and implementation trajectories.

replacement.title: Page Numbering From Second Page
replacement.definition: The first page must omit its footer page number, with page numbering displayed beginning on the second page.

patches.decision_note: The page-numbering rule is an independently evolving document behavior that is currently embedded in evidence for legacy copy-paste stability but has no suitable Requirement.
The client's 'Sounds great' may acknowledge the freelancer generally or may accept English as the default language; this materially determines whether the current MODIFY and RESUME Events are valid.
